title: Real Spring batch cancellation integration
implemented_scope: Actual Spring annotation transaction proxy and JDBC transaction manager on H2: checked and runtime rollback, atomic batch inventory and order updates, repeat-cancel and delivered guard, per-batch SQL row locking, concurrent delivery versus cancel, and atomic shared inventory increment.
not_implemented_or_unmeasured: No finite production connection pool or pool exhaustion test
Public tests, no hidden evaluation or model ranking
Trusted candidate code only; no hostile-code sandbox
Maven manifest provided, Maven lifecycle unexecuted
No production load calibration; bounded progress deadlines are not performance scores
No HTTP/controller/auth, persistence across process restart, deadlock retry, mixed SKU cancellation ordering, or broad randomized schedule coverage
Per-batch pessimistic locking is required here; this is not an oracle for optimistic implementations
Spring 6.2.12 is a reproducibility pin, not a latest-version or security recommendation
